status: Integrated and packaged checks verified in Prototype 35 / 0.35.0; live visual review and Sean difficulty remain open.
aiming: All eight directions airborne; all except straight down grounded. Aim visible without firing.

animation_audit.scope: All hero sprite sheets, manifests and runtime paths, including legacy and modular aiming, supported current weapons and future unsupported assets labeled honestly.
animation_audit.cross_product: Both heroes × each valid aim direction × locomotion state × firing/not firing; also transitions and facing mirrors.
acceptance: No running movement with frozen legs for any valid aim.
Jump poses respond to vertical phase and landing; no standing body floating through jumps.
Weapon/arms stay registered to moving body; muzzle tracks pose.
Recoil never suppresses locomotion or persistent aim.
Audit records missing assets versus renderer bugs, with honest readiness status.

lives.meaning: Three total lives including current life, not three spare retries
lives.hud: One selected-hero head icon per remaining life
lives.death: At zero health enter nonlooping death animation, disable player control/firing, consume exactly one life, prevent repeat damage/decrements.
lives.respawn: If lives remain, respawn at active checkpoint or entrance with full selected-hero health and usual protection; preserve established enemy/checkpoint persistence.
lives.game_over: At zero lives show Game Over with deliberate Retry and Return to Main Menu. Retry starts a fresh run with three lives.
lives.art: Distinct Tony and Sean head icons and death animations; grounded and airborne death must settle believably rather than freeze in midair.
lives.status: Three lives and hero-head HUD explicitly requested; lifecycle details are initial implementation defaults.

developer_restart.controller: Hold left trigger and right trigger, then press Start; rising Start edge only, requires release before another activation.
developer_restart.input_guard: Chord takes precedence over pause; consumed input must not fire a shot, toggle pause or leak into restarted run. No activation while typing/dialogue/menu interaction.
developer_restart.keyboard: No replacement keyboard shortcut requested; remove R and retain non-player-facing development tooling.
developer_restart.documentation: Do not list secret restart in player Controls, prompts, tutorials or user-facing roadmap; technical handoff/tests may document it.

delivery: Engineering owns runtime/build/roadmap. Preserve shared edits; no game launch/foreground without permission; capture actual storybook after permitted visual validation.

runtime.coverage: 240 phase/aim/fire cases; six run frames; mirrored muzzles; lifecycle/input tests pass.
runtime.full_route: Tony passes; Sean bot exhausts three lives. Difficulty and human playtest remain open.
runtime.visual: Static Art preview reviewed; live game not launched. Stride and shoulder polish remain.
